title: Planet Crisis Response — Venezuela Earthquake (2026)
description: Planet Crisis Response Program imagery documenting the 24 June 2026 earthquake that struck Venezuela's coast, causing extensive damage in Caracas, La Guaira, Catia La Mar, Puerto Cabello, Valencia, Ocumare de la Costa and Yumare. The catalog is split into **pre-event** (a Q1 2026 Planet quarterly basemap for before/after comparison) and **post-event** high-resolution SkySat and Pelican collects (50 cm) acquired 26–28 June 2026, organised by affected location. Each Item bundles the visual, pansharpened-analytic and usable-data-mask COGs. Imagery © Planet Labs PBC, licensed CC-BY-NC-4.0.
